decisions.reason: After four years on the market, continued survival suggests results are at least near aspiration levels, so a medium-sized German trailer maker would likely keep this core-aligned box trailer series unless portfolio overlap forces later pruning.

The low-bed trailer series fits the firm's established professional hauling capabilities and, absent clear signs of underperformance, behavioral-theory logic implies it remains above the withdrawal threshold and is kept.

This second box trailer series still fits core competences, but overlap with another box trailer line raises the chance that management will reallocate resources if comparative performance falls short of aspiration levels.
